name: Hotel Cafe Royal
insider_take: Where royalty once sipped champagne and Oscar Wilde held court—this Regent Street legend has been the epicenter of London's cultural scene since 1865.
whats_special: The stunning Grill Room features the world's largest collection of David LaChapelle artwork, while the Oscar Wilde Bar occupies the exact spot where the famous writer used to entertain. The hotel's Napoleon III architecture houses London's most opulent suites, including the palatial Dome Penthouse with its own private rooftop terrace overlooking Regent Street.
pro_tip: Book afternoon tea in the legendary Oscar Wilde Bar during weekdays—you'll avoid crowds and can fully appreciate the room's rich literary history and exquisite cocktail program.
dont_miss: The Green Bar's innovative cocktails crafted with house-grown herbs, and the Akasha Holistic Wellbeing Centre's swimming pool beneath a stunning glass dome. Step outside to explore luxury shopping on Regent Street or catch a West End show just minutes away in Theatreland.
pros: Historic landmark hotel with over 150 years of heritage in Regent Street
Prime location in the heart of London's shopping and theater district
Luxurious Akasha spa and wellness center with holistic treatments
Multiple award-winning restaurants including Oscar Wilde Bar
cons: Busy central location with high foot traffic
